source: Ed4 C.4.10, pp.C-43 to C-45; C.7.1.1.1 Tables C-10 and C-15, pp.C-79 and C-84
description: A MANAGEMENT D_PDU from a peer is acknowledged with a MANAGEMENT D_PDU with ACK set, sent ahead of other traffic; queued non-ARQ data to the same peer follows it in the same transmission.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). At 1500, during the burst, conn 1 sends an S_UNIDATA_REQUEST (priority 0, SAP 5 at 0.0.1.3, DELIVERY MODE default, TTL 0 so TTD = 1500 + 1296000000 ms, U_PDU "hello", no confirmation): no SIS output (A-0095). At 2000 a MANAGEMENT D_PDU (type 6) from 0.0.1.3 to 0.0.1.2, address size 4, EOT 10 (end 7000), EOW 0xF01 (CAPABILITY, Ed4), VALID MESSAGE 1, ACK 0, EXTENDED MESSAGE 0, frame ID 5, with the five NOT USED bits of byte 4+m set, which are ignored (C-1020). RX MANAGEMENT FRAME ID starts above 255 (C-0310), so frame 5 is new (C-0315) and is acknowledged (C-0296). Burst end 3000: csma.vdcd_end 4000; at 7000 rule 1, CONT_WAIT 45000 (slot 15); at 52000 one transmission: first the acknowledgement (C-0297, C-1041), type 6 from 0.0.1.2 to 0.0.1.3, address size 4, EOW 0 EMPTY, VALID MESSAGE 0, ACK 1, EXTENDED MESSAGE 0, no extended bytes, frame ID 5, the frame ID it acknowledges (C-0302, C-0304, C-1073); then the type 7 for "hello" (C_PDU ID 0, offset 0, DATA C_PDU holding the DATA S_PDU SAP 5 to SAP 5 with its TTD), which may follow once the acknowledgement is placed (C-0635, C-1070). Both lie in block 0 of a one-block transmission (duration 5550), so EOT 10 and the type 7's reception window 10. Nothing is queued at transmit_done.
